description: Land Acquisition - Udagaladebokka, Minipe D/S Division Kandy District  - Nedalagamuwa, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes (including conservation), provides detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and extents. While a government minister is named, the primary focus is on land matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
